blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas women’s beach volleyball teams begin their medal quests in the Asian Games 2026 on Sunday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court in Aichi, Japan. Southeast Asian Games gold medalists Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons and the fast-rising tandem of Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara play in their respective groups, where the top two will advance to the round of 16. Rondina and Pons make their Asian Games debuts in Pool E, taking on Most Sabina Khatun and Mst Lucky Khatun of Bangladesh at 12 noon (Philippine time).
